summary: tax_for now returns None for an unknown region instead of zero tax. Its two callers, order_total and tax_line, still do arithmetic on the result.

findings.title: None return crashes order_total and tax_line
findings.problem: tax_for now returns None for an unknown region. order_total adds the result to an int, and tax_line divides it by 100.
findings.consequence: Checkout raises TypeError for any order shipped to a region missing from RATES. Receipt printing raises the same error for that order.
findings.fix: Keep returning 0 for an unknown region. Otherwise, update order_total and tax_line in the same change to handle None.

findings.title: No test covers the unknown region branch
findings.problem: The change adds a None branch to tax_for for an unknown region. No test in the repository runs tax_for or its callers.
findings.consequence: No test fails when a caller breaks on the new return value.
findings.fix: Add tests that call tax_for, order_total and tax_line with an unknown region.
